gaps.sentence: Don't disturb him — he ___ an important video call with the client.

gaps.sentence: I can't talk now — I ___ dinner for twelve people.

gaps.sentence: The wedding guests ___ when the string quartet began to play.
gaps.hint: in progress when the music began

gaps.sentence: I ___ dinner when the lights went out.
gaps.hint: the lights went out interrupted it

gaps.sentence: When I got to the office, I realised I ___ my security pass.
gaps.hint: the forgetting happened before realising it

gaps.sentence: She ___ two majors when she was at university.
gaps.hint: a completed period in the past
gaps.explanation: A completed past period takes the past simple: did.

gaps.sentence: At the moment, the council ___ whether to sell the library.
gaps.hint: at the moment shows an ongoing process
gaps.explanation: 'At the moment' marks an ongoing process, so the present continuous fits: is deciding.
